description: This file defines an interface class IWebAudioPlayerService for managing web audio players within the Rialto server service. It declares virtual methods for creating, destroying, controlling playback, and querying buffer and device info related to web audio playback.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for web audio player management in the Rialto server service.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a web audio player with specified handle, client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the web audio player associated with the given handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames for the specified player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the specified web audio player.
